name: muton
description: Shared hive memory for coding agents — durable Cards with silent session reflection

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli/index.ts --target node --outfile ./dist/cli.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='dist/cli.js'; const b=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if(!b.startsWith('#!')) fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+b); fs.chmodSync(p,0o755);"
